targetText: Sismondi’s view that accumulation (the growth of production in general) is determined by consumption, and his incorrect explanation of the realisation of the aggregate social product (which he reduces to the workers’ share and the capitalists’ share of revenue) naturally and inevitably led to the doctrine that crises are to be explained by the discrepancy between production and consumption.
summary: Lenin rejects the vulgar underconsumptionist explanation of economic crises, arguing that crises stem not from consumption limits alone, but from the anarchy and contradictions of capitalist social production.
